programs.title: Postcards
programs.desc: Kris checks out the businesses along the main street of Barwon Heads. Madeline is in Highton, trying her hand at woodworking. Lauren samples the newest pizzeria in Carlton. And Shane finds a slice of Santorini in Oakleigh.

programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: This week on Getaway, showcasing how to do Bora Bora on a budget, cruising around Turkey plus going back to the time of the dinosaurs in outback Queensland.

programs.title: Building Roots
programs.sub_title: Pink Is Not in Their Vocabulary
programs.desc: A couple purchased a home with incredible mountain views, but the pink stucco siding creates the wrong kind of wow factor. Ben and Cristi open the home to enhance the surrounding landscape, using natural materials.

programs.title: Masters Of Flip
programs.desc: Kortney and Dave tackle a massive flip that requires a large bump out and a possible second building. As Kortney works with her team on a bright and airy design plan, Dave does everything in his power to scale down the size of the project.

programs.title: Fixer To Fabulous
programs.desc: A couple with family ties to Peru have purchased a small house they want to make their forever home, but it needs a lot of work. Dave and Jenny brighten up the home and incorporate a Peruvian design-style with personal touches and a chicken coop.

programs.title: 100 Day Dream Home
programs.desc: Mika and Brian create a family's dream home in the backyard of a childhood home. They aim to give them all the amenities without going over budget.
